Name: Zelda Items Pack (unofficial Content Patcher port)
Author: sacredkhaos
Description:
Adds Link's Cap (Hat) and swords (Weapons) from The Legend of Zelda series to Stardew Valley.
Mod originally created by SilentResident, I just converted it to Content Patcher from JSONAssets. The original mod is here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3645

Manifest.Name: (CP)SRZeldaPack
Manifest.Description: Adds Zelda weapons and Kokiri Cap via Content Patcher to Stardew Valley, unofficial port of SilentResident, zcsnightmare, yuikami, and Atomos' JsonAssets version
Manifest.Author: SilentResident, zcsnightmare, yuikami (hats) & Atomos (data)
